header: Week of Monday 7 September 2026 — built 2026-09-10 from 81 daily snapshots (2026-06-17 to 2026-09-09), 2,109 pieces with a price record across 187 labels.
79 pieces changed price in the comparable window and none of those changes has yet been seen in a second snapshot, so none of them is reportable.

Prices can only be compared over 2 snapshots this week, so every price story is held; 223 pieces down to one or two sizes and 656 listed by their shop in the last 7 days are what the record supports today.

notes: Lowest-ever prices, brand price discipline ("this label discounts N%") and "this price has held" are all HELD this week. price_records.json measures those inside the current pricing epoch, and the 2026-09-05 change plus its 3-day settle leaves only 2 comparable snapshots (2026-09-08 to 2026-09-09). Quoting them would be a statement about 2 days dressed up as one about 81. They come back on 2026-09-21 at the earliest.

All 79 dated price moves in the archive land on the last snapshot, so none has been seen twice yet. A move becomes reportable on the first later snapshot that still shows the new price (MOVE_MIN_CONFIRM_SNAPSHOTS); a move that reverts overnight never earns a post, which is the point of the rule.

No price claim is made about 28natelier, Anna October, Blanch Wear, Christopher Esber, Donde Esteban, My Mum Made It, Sir the Label, With Jéan: price_corrections.json still has an open FX repair window for each of them, which is that file's own statement that it does not vouch for those prices.

The Chicago story is a piece stocked by Gemini, 1911 W. Division St., Chicago, IL 60622 — the label itself is not Chicago-based, and the sheet does not say it is. brands.json has no city field on any label entry, so a Chicago DESIGNER cannot be identified from this data.
No story of these kinds was available: drop (confirmed markdown), lowest (lowest price on our record), hold (a price that will not move).
